local.label: Running locally
local.description: Runs as a process on the endpoint with the user's privileges.

network.label: Remote
network.description: Reached over HTTP, SSE or WebSocket.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: The collector could not classify the transport.

access.label: Access & execution
access.blurb: How agents reach tools: local servers, direct network endpoints, credentials in configuration.

permissions.label: Agent permissions
permissions.blurb: Switches that let an agent act without asking: browser and computer use, approvals, sandboxing, hooks, tooling.

content.label: Content trust
content.blurb: Skills and packs agents execute, and whether anyone reviewed them.

identity.label: Identity & sign-in
identity.blurb: How AI clients authenticate, and whether enterprise identity is in the loop.

discovery.label: Discovery gaps
discovery.blurb: Evidence the scan could not classify; re-scan or register to resolve.

hygiene.label: Configuration hygiene
hygiene.blurb: Disabled, cached, stale and orphaned entries that are safe to remove.

access.why: Control who can invoke tools, what permissions they receive, and when human confirmation is required. An audit trail makes sensitive actions traceable and supports investigation.
access.intro: For connectors that go through Palma's gateway:

capabilities.name: Scoped access
capabilities.text: Control tool access through spaces and permissions.

capabilities.name: Execution policies
capabilities.text: Block restricted actions or require human confirmation.

capabilities.name: Audit & oversight
capabilities.text: Review tool activity and export it to your SIEM.

permissions.why: A switch that lets an agent browse, control the desktop or run tools without asking removes the only human checkpoint on the endpoint. Governance moves that checkpoint to a policy you control.
permissions.intro: For governed tools, the checkpoint moves to a policy you control:

capabilities.name: Approval policies
capabilities.text: Require a human decision before a governed tool runs.

capabilities.name: Execution policies
capabilities.text: Block restricted actions outright, per space or tool.

capabilities.name: Audit & oversight
capabilities.text: See every governed call, who made it and what it touched.

content.why: Skills and packs are code and prompts an agent executes. Anything authored or side-loaded locally has not been reviewed for prompt injection, secrets or unsafe instructions.
content.intro: For skills and packs distributed through Palma:

capabilities.name: Skill catalog
capabilities.text: Publish skills through Palma, scanned for injection and secrets at publish time.

capabilities.name: Curated packs
capabilities.text: Distribute reviewed packs to the clients that should have them.

capabilities.name: Audit & oversight
capabilities.text: Know which version of a skill each environment runs.

identity.why: API keys and personal vendor accounts sit outside your identity provider: no SSO, no offboarding, no conditional access. Enterprise identity at the gateway brings AI clients back under it.
identity.intro: For clients that sign in through the gateway:

capabilities.name: Enterprise sign-in
capabilities.text: Clients authenticate to the gateway with your identity provider.

capabilities.name: Scoped access
capabilities.text: Entitlements follow the person, not a shared key.

capabilities.name: Audit & oversight
capabilities.text: Every call is attributed to an identity you manage.

discovery.why: Evidence the scan could not classify is neither safe nor unsafe: it is unknown. Resolving it is cheap and turns a gap into a decision.

hygiene.why: Entries that are disabled, cached, stale or orphaned do nothing today, but they are configuration nobody owns. Removing them shrinks what the next review has to read.

rules.title: Connectors running locally without monitoring or governance
rules.headline: {n} MCP connectors run as local processes {where}; local processes sit outside Palma's monitoring and governance
rules.action: Register them in Palma and route calls through the gateway, where approval policies audit every call.

rules.title: Credentials stored in local client config
rules.headline: {n} connectors keep a credential in plain text in a client configuration file {where}
rules.action: Move the credential behind the gateway and rotate the exposed value.

rules.title: Remote connectors used outside Palma's governance
rules.headline: {n} remote MCP connectors are used directly from AI clients {where}, outside Palma's governance
rules.action: Route them through Palma: the same tools, audited and governed per policy.

rules.title: Connectors signed in with a fixed secret
rules.headline: {n} connectors authenticate with a long-lived fixed secret {where}
rules.action: Let the gateway hold the credential, or move the server to OAuth.

rules.title: Connectors of unknown type
rules.headline: {n} connector entries could not be classified as local or remote {where}
rules.action: Re-scan with the current collector, or register the server so its transport is known.

rules.title: Disabled connector entries left in config
rules.headline: {n} connector entries are switched off but still in configuration {where}
rules.action: Remove them, or re-enable them deliberately.

rules.title: Local unaudited skills installed
rules.headline: {n} skills were written or installed locally {where}; nobody has audited them
rules.action: Publish them through Palma's skill catalog, which scans for prompt injection and secrets at publish.

rules.title: Skills that cannot be verified
rules.headline: {n} skills have no content digest {where}, so nobody can attest what they contain
rules.action: Re-scan; a skill whose folder cannot be read cannot be attested.

rules.title: Skills delivered through managed distribution
rules.headline: {n} skills arrive through managed distribution {where}
rules.action: Positive evidence; keep it on the coverage view.

rules.title: Packs installed outside any marketplace
rules.headline: {n} packs were installed by hand, outside any marketplace {where}
rules.action: Inventory them now; governed conversion registers the ones that stay.

rules.title: Packs of unknown origin
rules.headline: {n} packs have no recorded origin {where}
rules.action: Inventory them now; governed conversion registers the ones that stay.

rules.title: Disabled pack entries left in config
rules.headline: {n} packs are switched off but still declared {where}
rules.action: Hygiene: remove the entries, or re-enable them deliberately.

rules.title: Packs downloaded but not installed
rules.headline: {n} pack downloads sit in caches without an installation {where}
rules.action: Clear the caches, or install the packs deliberately.

rules.title: AI clients signed in with API keys
rules.headline: {n} AI clients use API keys {where}; a key sits outside your company's identity provider
rules.action: Move clients to enterprise identity through the gateway.

rules.title: AI clients on personal or cloud accounts, not company identity
rules.headline: {n} AI clients sign in with personal vendor or cloud accounts {where}, not your company's identity
rules.action: Move clients to enterprise identity through the gateway.

rules.title: AI client config left behind without an installation
rules.headline: {n} AI clients are configured but not installed {where}
rules.action: Remove stale configuration.
